SELECT h.helper_id AS helperId, h.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS memberNickname, m.invite_code AS memberInviteCode, h.helper_member_id AS helperMemberId, hm.nickname AS helperNickname, hm.invite_code AS helperInviteCode, h.remark, h.create_time AS createTime FROM t_helper h INNER JOIN t_wx_member m ON m.member_id = h.member_id AND m.deleted_flag = 0 INNER JOIN t_wx_member hm ON hm.member_id = h.helper_member_id AND hm.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE h.deleted_flag = 0
AND (h.member_id = #{query.memberId} OR h.helper_member_id = #{query.memberId})
AND ( m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.searchWord}, '%') OR hm.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.searchWord}, '%') OR m.invite_code = #{query.searchWord} OR hm.invite_code = #{query.searchWord} )
AND h.create_time >= #{query.beginDate}
AND h.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY h.helper_id DESC
